summary: The registrant, ASML Holding N.V., filed a Form 6-K disclosing results of its Annual General Meeting held on April 22, 2026. The AGM approved routine items: adoption of 2025 financial statements, dividend payments totaling €7.50 per share, discharge of management/supervisory board, reappointments and appointments of board members, and auditor appointment. Authorizations granted include issuance of shares up to 10% and share repurchase up to 10% of issued capital, valid through October 22, 2027. There is no special situation; this is a routine AGM disclosure without material corporate action. No deal terms or strategic changes are involved.
